waText:
🌵 *This weekend in Tesoro Highlands*
Lots to do this weekend—something for everyone in Tesoro Highlands.

🏛️ *Fri 10 AM* — Hart Mansion Group Tour 10:00a.m. (free)
   Free local history tour, perfect for families.
🏍️ *Sat 9 AM* — Motorcycles and Coffee (free)
   Free Sunday morning meet-up for all ages and interests.
🎪 *Sat 10 AM* — SCV HOME & SUMMER FUN EXPO (free)
   Kids love expos—bouncy castles, games, summer fun.
🎭 *Sat 2 PM* — The Lightning Thief: The Percy Jackson Musical at Canyon Theatre Guild
   Percy Jackson on stage, great for tweens and families.
🎵 *Sat 7 PM* — Voice United - Gospel Music CONCERT! ($15.18–$28.52)
   Gospel concert, weekend evening entertainment.
🥕 *Sun 8:30 AM* — Old Town Newhall Farmers Market (free)
   Free farmers market in Newhall, local favorite.

Full list → https://tesorohighlands.com/events
